tei:div.tei:p: 'dza' mtshon dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi sgrub chen 'don 'grigs bzhugs// (70)bla la phyag 'tshal lo/

'dza' tshon spyi 'dus sgrub chen la/ sna sel du/ sats+tsha gdab/ srog blu/ rdo rje rnam 'dzoms/ dme brtsegs khrus/ na raka skong bshags/ yig brgya bzla/ sems bskyed blang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtsa gsum tshogs bskang*/ sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ lhor stobs so che/ nub tu lang gshegs/ byang du tog gzungs gra lnga bton/ chu gtor/ mdos glud/ gtor bsngo/ lus sbyin rnams/ phur pa lta bu'i gtor bzlog gi dam sri ling ga la 'gugs pa brgya tshar bya/ ༈ sa chog la/ gzhi steng tshom bu gcig bkod/ mdun du dkar gtor gnyis/ gser skyems/ mchod pa bskor bshams bya/ lcog rtse gcig steng rin chen 'bar ba/ sman raka nyer spyod bcas bshams/ hrī sngon/ spos phyung*/ brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus gcig las byang gter gzhung skyang pa ltar ni/ hrīḥ bdag nyid 'gyur med= skyabs gnas dam pa= lan gsum/ chos rnams= mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa/ bstod pa yan/ bsnyen dmigs gzhung ltar la/ thod phreng (71) rtsal brgya/ sid+dhi stong gcig dang nyis brgya tshar nas/ mtha'i bsdu ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ snod bcud snang srid= chen por shog bar sgrub khog gi dbu nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= mchod pa dang gtor ma byin brlabs/ bam̐ las= thim par gyur/ dkar gtor phyir phul/ bhu mi pa ti= gshegs par bsam/ gtor ma gser skyems phul/ bdag nyid las kyi= dbang phur gdab/ sa sbyang ba/ bsreg gtor sbyangs/ rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por gyur/ bar 'don/ khro bo la dur khrod= zhes pa de bskur/ las byang gi bgegs gtor/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ bgegs gtor= sum+bha ni= hrīḥ bdag nyid 'gyur med= dzā la raṃ: bar/ sgrub khog gi/ bdag gi thugs ka nas= gha gha= tshar gsum/ phur bu= khengs par gyur/ | rgyal tho ni/ tho byang*/ dkar gtor bzhi/ nyer spyod/ dam sri ling ga man chas byas pa/ gser skyems skyer phur sor bzhi pa/

thun rdzas/ gu gul/ dur rdo la ri gling rgya gram bris pa/ sa chu me rlung*/ sats+tsha nag po rab gnas ma byas pa gcig sgo byang gnyis/ dmar gtor gnyis/ grub khung (72)du zan ling*/ skyer phur dbal la sngags dang shog dril can bcas khur nas/ sgrub khang gi shar du/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta= mchod pa gtor ma byin rlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal= gzhung gsal/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ bkra shis brjod/ lhor gong ltar mchod gtor byin rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= mchod pa gtor ma byin rlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal= gzhung gsal/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ bkra shis brjod/ lhor gong ltar mchod gtor byin rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bar/ bdag nyid= sogs/ de'i 'gros/ nub byang*/ tshar nas sgo drung du dong grus par mnan thod bcug gser skyems/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ sogs/ khyad par ma hā gu ru'i lha tshogs rnams/ kha bsgyur/ mthu dpung bskyed/ bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ atsika= hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ e yaṃ raṃ= 'gugs pa la/ khyad par ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs= sogs lan gsum/ hūm̐ dam sri= phur tshogs gdab: brjod dus skyer phur sor bzhi mnan dong du 'phen/ thun tshogs= sogs brjod dus/ thun brab/ gu gul bdug ri rab= sogs 'don dus/ dur rdos mnan/ sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum sats+tshas mnan la sas bkab/ hūm̐/ gcig ni= nan/ bar la/ las byang gi bro mnan/ bgegs rigs stong phrag= shis pa brjod/ sgo byang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ las sngags/ badz+ra a mṛ ta= swa bha ba= (73)tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ gong gi/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las a las= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bar/ 'og gi/ las sngags/ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i= tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ bkra shis shog sgo them nang gi grub khung gi zan ling la skyer phur sngags shog dril can btsugs la/ sgo 'di yan chad= 'don/ nang du 'ong ba dang*/ me thun chu thun bya/ gzhi steng ma tram̐ gzugs mgo lho nub tu bstan la bzhag a tsig= sngags dang*/ bdag nyid las kyi=

bden stobs dam sri mnan pa ltar kha bsgyur/ bden pa chen po'i= sogs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ spro na las byang gi bro brdung*/ ma tram̐ lhu tshigs gzhung gsal ltar phyogs so sor bkod/ hūm̐ dzña na= thim pas= 'og gi/ khog pa ye shes rol pa'i= tshud par gyur/ khro bcu 'phur pa bcu/ phur gdan rnams bkod/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ khra ོ bcu sngags so sor phur pa bkod/ khyab par gyur/ las byang gi srung 'khor/ hrīḥ bdag nyid 'gyur med= dz+wa la ram̐: dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ hūm̐ bla med= ༈ lha sta gon ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma= gzhi steng tshom bu gcig bkod/ sman raka gtor ma (74)mchod pa bskor bshams/ las byang gi/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ sman mchod dor ba'i/ bstod pa yan/ sgrub khog gi/ ho dus gsum= tshar gsum/ dra bar bzhugs par mos/ lha sta gon bsdu na/ tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa byin rlabs tshar nas/ 'og gi sgrub pa'i gzhir= gsal bar gyur/ las byang mchod bstod/ sgrub khog gsol gdab byas pas chog ༈ bum pa sta gon ni/ sum bha ni brjod tshe bum par gu gul bdug yungs dkar brab/ sid+dhi bzla zhing*/ bum rdzas blugs/ kha rgyan btsug tshom bu'i steng mañdzi la bkod/ badz+ra a mṛ ta= swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las= dbus su rgyal dbang dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ kha bsgyur/ gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= ma hā pañtsa= hrīḥ rgyal ba thams cad= sho lo kas bstod/ gzungs thag blang la/ rang gi thugs ka nas= 'khyil bar bsam/ thod phreng rtsal nyer gcig sid+dhi brgya tsam bzla/ las bum la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= nyer gcig tsam bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i/ ro gcig tu gyur/ bdag mdun bum lha pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar= sogs/ snga tshogs grol (75)rgyan bkod la/ gzhi steng ras bris bkram/ gzhi mdun sgrub rdzas/ sku gzugs tsaka li/ gzhung pod/ sngags byang*/ rdo rje/ thod pa/ tshe bum/ khaṭ+wam̐/ shel rdo/ rnam baṃ/

rtsa gsum gtor chen/ sman raka/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril/ tshe 'chang*/ mda' dar/ zhi rgyas dbang drag dang sde bdun gtor ma/ gter srung dkar dmar/ dkyil 'khor rgyan rdzas rnams stegs bu'i steng du bkod/ las byang mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ sid+dhi'i bsnyen pa brgya rtsa song ba'i bar btang*/ stong tshig mchod pa/ mchod 'os phyi nang= sho lo ka sngags bcas/ bstod pa/ hrīḥ rgyal ba thams cad= sho lo ka/ sid+dhi dzapa dbyangs bya tshe/ slob dpon gyis spos sna drangs/ sgrub rdzas rnams thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum tshar nas/ hūm̐/ bla med= tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas dkyil 'khor dbus su/ rnam bum/ ldeng khri gong mar sku gsung thugs rten/ rgyab ngos gtor chen/ rdo ra'i nang khro bcu'i phur pa/ mchod pa bskor bshams/ phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mda' dar me long can bzhi/ skur bzhir rgyal mtshan/ logs bzhir 'phan/ dar gyi dra phyed sogs brgyan/ steng du gdugs/ gsham du sgab dkris/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du/ sde bdun/ dkar dmar/ chad brtan rgyun bzhag sman raka gtor ma (76)mchod pa phreng tshar sogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang du lcags hom du nyul le'i ling ga/ las phur/ yungs dkar sogs thun rdzas sogs kyang tshang bar bsags/ de rnams bshams tshe/ bsam lhun/ sgrol ma/ zab mdo/ lo gyon ma'i bsnyen pa rnams 'don/ bshams bkod tshar nas/ bla med= khaṃ swa hā/ mnga' gsol skabs las rdor gyis tshig bstun/ thod chang drangs/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas= sogs/ chas rnams slob dpon la phul zhing*/ hūm̐ don dam= thams cad la 'grim/ brda sgo/ brda phyag rgyas bsdus gang mos gcig bsre bsnan ni/ las byang gi/ bdud rtsi byin brlabs/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi gnas gsum= aḥ 'og gi sman mchod khā hi bcas/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag nyid= yungs thun grab/ las byang gi bgegs bskrad/ deng 'dir dkyil 'khor=sum+bha ni= gu gul/ yungs thun bcas/

rdo rje slob dpon= rjes zlos*/ snying gar/ dam chu blud/ i dan+te= khas blang*/ dzab dbyangs lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi bkye/ phyogs 'don/ oṃ dpal ldan ko ྅ haṃ bar/ bla mas deng phyin chad= phyogs 'don/ sku gsung thugs= mchi bar gnang: bar/ bla mas/ rdo rje 'du 'bral= 'grub par shog: rdor dril byin brlabs mnyam 'don/ rol (77)mo byin brlabs 'ur sum brdung ba zhig bya/ bdag nyid= gshegs su gsol/ rtsa sngags/ sid+dhi= sa ma ya= dkyil 'khor la bstim bar/ byin 'bebs 'phags mchog thugs rje= dang*/ dus gsum bde gshegs dang*/ me tog char sil gsum rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig 'don/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum bya/ gral du 'khod nas/ sid+dhi dzab dbyangs lan gsum bya/ las byang gi smon lam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skyabs med= sogs bkra shis/ bsdu ldang*/ chen por shog bar/ de yan gyi bsnyen pa'i yan lag song*/ ༈ de nas nye bar bsnyen pa phrin las kyi gzhung bsrong ba dang*/ sgrub pa dngos dzab bzlas bar chad bsal ba rnams ni/ hrīḥsngon chab thugs/ spos phyung*/ brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig skye ba kun tu= las byang gi rang nyid skad cig= oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ lan gsum/ 'ur sum brdung gis/ deng 'dir= sogs/ dz+wa la ram̐: skyabs 'gro man hrug 'don bya/ yig brgya phreng bskor/ yig drug stong*/ rdor sems 'od zhu= sogs/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ sum brdung gis/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ lha brkyed/ spyan 'dren/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ sman mchod/ bstod pa yan/ 'dir dzab khang dbye ba ni/ (78)bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ phaṭa dzaḥ zhes brjod/ rang gi gnas gsum= thod phreng rtsal stong phrag tsam/ rang gi thugs kar= chen por gyur/ sid+dhi dzaḥ dbyangs lan gsum rjes thun bzung*/ de nas bzung bsnyen rgyun pas sgrub zhag ma rdzogs bar mnyam 'don mi dgos/ sngags sgra skad cig kyang mi bcad par bya/

sid+dhi khri gcig stong gnyis tsam song bas/ tshe sgrub/ bdag mdun skad cig gi= tshe bsnyen stong tshar/ nad rigs= smon lam/ tshe 'gugs bcas/ gur drag rnga bcas 'don/ a tsika stong*/ sham bu sbyar ba brgya/ rang nyid rig 'dzin= rnga bcas seng gdong*/ mchod pa mthar/ bsnyen dmigs/ aḥkaḥ stong*/ spyi bor aḥkaḥ= brlag par gyur/ aḥkaḥ brgya mkha' 'gro ma thal rdeb lan gsum/ rang nyid pad 'byung= las bzhi bsnyen pa rnams sid+dhi sham du sbyar ba brgya re/ brlag gyur cig 'grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya rnams gsum gsum/ ye dhar lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod bya mchod 'os= shau lo ka sngags bcas/ hrīḥrgyal ba= sho lo ka/ dge ba 'di yi= 'di ltar bskyed rdzogs= sum brdung gi/ gtor 'bul/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ bdag nyid pad+ma = (79) oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'ur sum brdung*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dkon mchog= mdzod/ 'dir spro na rtse le'i gtor bsngos 'ja' tshon rang lugs kyi bka' srung rnams dgos kyang dpe 'byor dka' bas rnying phyogs srung ma gtso che'i rigs rat+na'i sde bdun du 'du bas/ sde bdun 'khrugs pa bsal te bshags pa'i mthar/ na raka skong bshags mar me'i smon lam bcas/ de nang yig brgya phreng skor 'gro nges bya/ sum brdung gis las byang tshogs/ hrīḥbadag nyid= snang srid gang: 'ur sum brdung*/ rang bzhin= khā hiḥ gnam chos yaṃ bskang gnyis/ skong rdzas byin rlabs/ skong ba hrīḥ ma bcos= tshogs bshags/ sde bdun bskang ba/ hūm̐ ma hāḥ 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang= bar gnam phud bcas/ 'dir spro na cha gsum btang*/ tshogs drang ba/ bsam lhun 'don cing tshogs thams cad la bkye/ lhag ma bsdu/ gtsang lhag steng du bzhag ste lhag ma byin brlabs dang*/ gzhung gi lhag ma 'don zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub tu lhag ma btson du 'dzin/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ sde bdun phrin bcol/ hūm̐/ bka' srung dam can= mtha' bar 'don dus dkar dmar gser skyems bcas 'bul/

las byang gilachad tho/ brtan ma/ 'gugs pa bcas bro mnan/ bdag cag mchog grub= rjes chog(80)mchod bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= brtan bzhugs smon lam/ shis brjod/ bsdu ldang*/ rgyal dkyil dang*/ bzang spyod smon lam bcas btang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nyul le'i ho ma bcas dang*/ las phur/ thun rdzas rnams bkod/ sgrub khog na ni/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ= sogs/ bsgyur dam sri mnan skabs ltar/ 'gugs pa lan gsum/ phur thun tsham bskul/ shar phyogs dkar mo/ bcas/ shis brjod/ de ma thag byin 'bebs rgyas bsdus gang rung 'don/ dzab dbyangs lan gsum tshar nas bzlas pa la 'jug/ mtshan thun bzhi drug gang byed la las byang mchod pa byin brlabs nas bstod pa yan/ bsnyen dmigs gzhung ltar la/ thod phreng rtsal nyer gcig sid+dhi la thun bzung*/ thun mthar/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ ye shes lha tshogs spyi ltar brjod rjes/ sgrub khog gi/ drag sngags so lnga dang*/ oṃ gha gha= phaṭaḥ byin 'bebs bsdus pa gcig dzab dbyangs lan gsum brjod cing grol lo// ༈ nyin gnyis pa phyin chad la/ hrīḥsngon/ spos phyung las byang bgegs gtor nas/ sid+dhi 'gor slebs dus/ ༈ bsnyen rgyun pas/ dbyangs gsal sogs dang*/ mchod 'os phyi nang= rgyal ba thams cad= kyi mchod bstod dge bsngo/ 'di ltar bskyed (81)rdzogs bcas/ hrīḥsngon/ spos phyung*/ brgyud 'debs/ las byang*/ bdag nyid 'gyur med= nas gter gzhung skyangs chog dus ltar/ thod phreng rtsal nyer gcig tsam/ sid+dhi la thun bzung*/ ༈ dge slong bzhi sde zhig gis rgyal tho sgo byang rnams khar song 'jug dus ltar tho gsos la pheb/ dam sri mnan pa 'dor pas chog gzhung chen po'i las byang gi bsnyen grangs khar seng ltar la/ tshe sgrub/ drag po/ seng gdong gi aḥkaḥgong mang stong rtsa yan song nas snga thun rnams la zlog dmigs thal rdeb gnyis bskyur/ las bzhi'i mchod bstod dge bsngo yan song nas/

nyu le bskrad gzir bsdus pa sgrub khog gi drag sngags so lnga dang*/ oṃ gha gha= sogs/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar/ byin 'bebs me tog char sil btang*/ thun gnyis pa/ las byang mchod pa byin brlabs nas/ zhi ba/ tshe sgrub/ drag po/ seng gdong*/ zlog dmigs thal rdeb gnyis bskur/ las bzhi/ mchod bstod dge bsngo/ nyul le bskrad gzir bsdus pa/ byin 'bebs 'phags mchog ma btang*/ las byang nam btang yang bsnyen grangs gong gsal 'gro nges pa las nyung mi bcug pa gal che/ thun gsum pa la/ las byang mchod brlabs nas/ zhi/ tshe drag seng (82)'di skabs zlog dmigs/

spyi bo a ཿkaḥdang*/ thal rdeb/ mkha' 'gro ma= gnyis 'don/ las bzhi/ mchod bstod/ gtor 'bul/ sde bdun/ na raka skong bshags/ tshogs/ skong ba/ sde bdun skong ba/ gnam phud/ cha gsum/ drang ba/ bsam lhun/ lhag ma/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ sde bdun phrin bcol/ chad rten/ bro mnan/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs smon lam/ bkra shis/ bsdu ldang*/ bzang spyod/ nyul le bskrad pa/ rgyas pa/ byin 'bebs/ dus gsum bde legs= dzab dbyangs bcas dang*/ mtshan thun bcas btang lugs khar seng ji lta ba bzhin byas pas chog go// nyin phyi ma rnams la 'di'i nyin par 'don lugs khog ji lta ba las 'dra min ci'ang mi dgos/ bsnyen rgyun dang*/ mtshan thun men na yang*/ dbu 'dzugs nyin gcig dngos gzhi nyin gsum gsum/ rjes chog nyin gcig bcas nyin zhag so lnga tshogs rgyu grub na spyi 'dus zhi drag seng gsum ka'i bsnyen tshad legs par 'gro ba yin no// bdun sgrub kyi tshe 'byor mkhos yod na/ rdor sems/ tshe chog phur pa gsum kyi sgrub pa yang dgos/ thun re re'i mtshams su/ chags med zhabs kyi gsung dngos grub skyol ba'i bsang gsur dang*/ (83)chu sna 'thor ba sogs bya/ gnang nyin sgrub pa grol ba'i de ring snga thun byin 'bebs 'phros su 'ur bdun brdung gsum 'phros su/ sgrub khog gi rgyun gyi dngos grub blang ba/ hūm̐ bde gshegs rgyal ba= dngos grub stsol/ 'ur sum brdung*/ bar las byang sman mchod/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas de mchod do oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsham bskur ba mtha' bar/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba = spyi 'gros dang*/ a la la ho/ 'ur sum brdung*/ bdud rtsi myong*/ thun gnyis pa/ las bum sgrub nas lha khang sogs sku gsung thugs rten rnams la lha khrus bya/ bsnyen pa 'gor bya srol yod/ phyin chad sngar ltar/ de nas sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ni/ sang nyin sgrub pa grol rgyu'i de ring thun gsum pa'i las bzhi grub nas/

dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gzhi dkar po'i steng gro yi g.yung drung bris pa'i khar/ nor bu dang*/ las bzhi 'brang rgyas/ zas sna/ tshe ril/ thod chang bcas bshams/ sgrub khog gi slar rang gi thugs ka= gzi byin 'bar bar gyur/ thod phreng rtsal/ sid+dhi/ atsig a ka bcas sbrel ma'i sham du/ kā ya wāka= btags pa brgya/ mchod bstod/ bka' sru+ung sogs sngar ltar/ (84)bsdu ldang rjes/ nyul le bskrad pa/ byin 'bebs/ dzab dbyangs rjes khang steng du dngos grub len chog lan gsum/ dngos grub bskul pa hūm̐ bde gshegs= sman mchod/ a la la ho bar/ ༈ grol nyin snga bar lang la/ hrīḥsngon nas bzung*/ bsnyen pa rnams cung zad nyung bcug las bzhi tshar nas/ sgrub khog gi slar yang rang gi= 'bar bar gyur/ thod phreng*/ sid+dhi/ drag seng sngags sham/ kā ya= btags pa bdun tsam bzla/ bsnyen rgyun pas kyang dngos grub blang*/ sngags rgyun/ mchod bstod/ bka' srung*/ na raka skong bshags/ tshogs/ bskang ba/ chos skyong skang ba'i skabs nyul le ling ga mer bsreg cing sde bdun gtor mar bstab/ de nas dngos grub len chog ni/ las byang bgegs bskrad/ deng 'dir dkyil 'khor= sum bha ni= hrīḥbadag nyid= dz+wa la raṃ: bar/ sgrub khog gi byin 'bebs dus gsum bde gshegs= lta bu/ ye shes sku mchog= sgrub khog gi/ 'ur sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ lha dang rig 'dzin= lta bu gnyis tshar nas/ hūm̐ āḥ 'ur sum brdung gis bzhag de ltar hrug 'don/ 'khyil bar gyur/ thod phreng*/ sid+dhi/ drag seng sbrel ma'i sham du/ kā yaḥ btags pa brgya/ dngos grub=(85)thams cad= thim par bsam/ skya rengs 'char ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs rten/ rnam bum sogs sgrub rdzas rnams btegs la/ hrīḥ ye shes lus can= bstsal du gsol/ bar/ las byang gi dngos grub bskul pa/ e ma ho bdag gzhan= sid+dhi hūm̐/ bar/ gong gi sngags sbrel ma'i sham/ kā ya= sogs btags pa bsgrangs la/ sgrub rdzas gnas gsum gtugs/

dngos grub rdzas rnams rol/ stan thog de nyid du= thob par bsam/ bar/ 'di man/ bsnyen rgyun pas kyang mnyam 'don yin/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg bya na/ zhi rgyas gnyis gang rung gi lha sngags ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha 'gro dgos pas/ ma mtha' yang stong gcig las mi nyung ba byed/ gzhan don dbang bskur na/ 'di nyid kyi rtsa dbang dang tshe dbang sogs bya'o// de nas tshogs drang ba/ bsam lhun lhag ma btong tshe btson du bzung ba'i lhag ma dang lhan cig sgrub khang gi lho nub tu bskyal/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ sde bdun phrin bcol dus chos skyong gtor ma thams cad khang thog tu 'phul/ chad brtan 'don dus rgyun bzhag phyir 'bul/ rta bro brdung*/ gtong rag mchod bstod rgyas pa las byang gi mchod bstod yongs rdzogs/ yig brgya gsum/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= ba rtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ snod bcud= sid+dhi hūm̐ (86) sgrub khog gi hūm̐ ngar 'dzin rnam dag= tsit+ta hūm̐: de nas rgyal tho bsdu ba la/ dkar gtor bzhi/ dmar gtor gnyis/ phyi mchod bcas thogs nas/ shar gyi tho rtsar/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin brlabs btsugs dus ltar ram/ bsdu na/ ram̐ yam̐= badz+ra muḥ lho/ nub/ byang*/ phyi sgo/ nang sgo bcas tshar nas nang du log khro bcu phur pa mas rim nas blang ste/ oṃ badz+ra kī li= tshar bcu oṃ ru ru= phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ a ka ro brjod pas ras bris bsdu'o// mched gral phan tshun lhan cig tu 'tshal nas/ ho thams cad rdo rje= slob dpon la phyag 'tshal/ ho rdo rje slob dpon= gral du 'khod nas/ kye ho/ mi gnas= thams cad kyi lag tu mar me dang*/ spos re thogs te/ hūm̐ bla med= yongs rdzogs shog de nas bla mas bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur bcas bzang spyod smon lam lhan cig bton/ las byang gi smon lam/ bkra shis dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing rol mo yang rgya cher bsgrags pas dge legs su bya'o//

las byang gi gzung snang thams cad= chen por shog snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i rol pa shes pa'i ngang nas spyod lam la 'jug go// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag che// (87)mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i dbang po yis// tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung nas// gzhan phan phrin las mthar phyin shog ces pa'ang dkon mchog spyi 'dus las byang rnam snang lo rtsa ba blo gros mtha' yas kyis bsgrigs ma dang*/ de mthun gter mdzod spyi'i sgrub khog gcig shes kun grol la brten nas dpal khyim chos 'byung gnas su sgrub chen bgyid pa'i cha rkyen rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i phyag bzhes dang bstun te rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyi sarda go lha ri 'od gsal gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ zhus so/// / (88 89)
